mcqs.question: Where and when will COP16 of the Convention on Migratory Species be held?
mcqs.explanation: COP16 of the Convention on Migratory Species will be held in Germany in 2029, marking 50 years of the CMS. Gandhinagar hosted COP13 in 2020, while Campo Grande hosted COP15 in 2026; Bonn is the CMS headquarters and not the venue of COP16.
